outputs.explanation: Panel A is a stacked bar/area chart showing median promoter-state frequencies across many continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters), functioning as a trend/line-type visualization across bins rather than a simple bar chart of a few group means. Overlaying individual data points for thousands of promoters across each bin would be unreadable, so this falls under the line-plot exemption.

Panel B is a single-molecule stack (heatmap-like) plot where each row already represents an individual DNA molecule (2952 molecules shown), so individual data points are inherently displayed; the summary sidebar frequencies are derived directly from the visible individual molecules, consistent with the heatmap exemption.

Same representation as panel A (mouse data, n=6122 promoters) — a stacked bar/area chart across continuous bins, which falls under the line-plot exemption since individual data points cannot be meaningfully overlaid.
Same representation as panel B (mouse Skp1 locus) — a single-molecule stack heatmap where each row is an individual molecule (2871 molecules), so individual data are already displayed.

Panel E is a box plot showing PIC occupancy distributions, which already displays the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so it is exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points.

Panel F is a box plot showing Pol II occupancy distributions, which already displays the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so it is exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points.
